title: Inpainting Insights: Elevating Visual XAI with Photorealistic Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2607.15482v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The increasing complexity of state-of-the-art machine learning models has made their behavior progressively harder to interpret, spurring rapid advancements in the field of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Among many methods proposed, perturbation-based approaches play a major role. By systematically altering (perturbing) input features, these approaches measure the impact on the model's predictions. For image data, traditional perturbation techniques, often involve replacing pixel values e.g., with a pre-defined color. However, such approaches, but also more refined deterministic techniques, generate unrealistic out-of-distribution samples and often leave visible artifacts, which can mislead the model and compromise explanation quality. translated_title: 修复洞见：利用照片级逼真的扰动提升视觉可解释人工智能（XAI）
translated_abstract: 最先进的机器学习模型日益复杂，使其行为越来越难以解释，这推动了可解释人工智能（XAI）领域的快速发展。在众多已提出的方法中，基于扰动的方法扮演着重要角色。这类方法通过系统地改变（扰动）输入特征，来衡量其对模型预测的影响。对于图像数据，传统的扰动技术通常涉及用预定义颜色等替换像素值。然而，这类方法以及更精细的确定性技术，都会生成不真实的分布外样本，并常常留下可见的伪影，这可能误导模型并损害解释质量。在这项工作中，我们对广泛使用的基于扰动的方法LIME进行了调整，以展示生成式图像修复如何改进基于扰动的图像解释。我们实现了照片级逼真的……
tldr: 该论文改进了广泛使用的基于扰动的方法LIME，利用生成式图像修复技术生成照片级逼真的扰动样本，解决了传统扰动方法产生不真实分布外样本和可见伪影的问题，从而提升视觉XAI的图像解释质量。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts LIME, a widely used perturbation-based method, by leveraging generative inpainting to create photorealistic perturbations, addressing the unrealistic out-of-distribution samples and visible artifacts of traditional perturbation techniques to elevate the quality of visual XAI explanations for images.
